title: Open restriction comparison for supplied derived projection mates
statement: Let f:X→Y be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with supplied derived localizations in universe w [def-pc-derived-category], their fixed tensor [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback] and direct image [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Fix an adjunction p:Lf* ⊣ Rf* and a natural tensor comparison t:Lf*(- tensor -) ≅ Lf*(-) tensor Lf*(-). For quasi-coherent derived M on Y and L on X, an open U of Y, and the explicitly specified inverse-image source Z and restricted morphism g (given equalities hZ and hg), the restriction [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] of the projection mate defined by p and t is isomorphic in the arrow category to a projection mate defined by an adjunction q and natural tensor comparison s for g and quasi-coherent local objects N,E. Use the shared small localizations in universe u on Z and U. There is no assertion of invertibility of either projection mate, and no quasi-compactness or quasi-separatedness hypothesis.

source.place: Lemma 36.22.1, first sentence of proof; Tag 08FE, Lemma 20.32.4, and the adjunction definition of the projection map

proof.text: Use hZ and hg to identify g with the canonical restricted morphism. Construct N and E as the actual restrictions of M and L. Apply the quasi-coherence restriction criterion in every degree and Mathlib isQuasicoherent_over.
Obtain the descended adjunction q and coherent pullback/direct-image comparisons alpha and beta.
Obtain the descended tensor comparison s, tensor restriction comparisons rhoX/rhoY and their equation before transposition.

Define a by tensor restriction followed by beta, c by tensor restriction followed by alpha, and b by beta followed by local direct image of c. The Hom-equivalence identity, q.homEquiv_naturality_right, the tensor/counit equation and q.homEquiv_naturality_left show that the mate square commutes. Arrow.isoMk then gives the required arrow isomorphism.

proof_origin.note: F2: explicit quasi-coherent restrictions and categorical mate square; coherent adjunction descent and tensor/counit descent are separated.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_derivedProjectionMate_openRestriction_comparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X))
    (M : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Y) (L : schemeDerivedQCohCategory X)
    (U : Y.Opens)
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (g : Z ⟶ U.toScheme)
    (hZ : Z = (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (hg : HEq g (f ∣_ U)) :
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) :=
        inferInstance
    letI : HasDerivedCategory.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace)) := inferInstance
    ∃ (q : derivedPullback g ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage g)
        (s : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
          (derivedPullback g).prod (derivedPullback g) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Z))
        (N : schemeDerivedQCohCategory U.toScheme) (E : schemeDerivedQCohCategory Z),
        Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((schemeOpenRestriction Y U).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (p.homEquiv (M.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj)
            ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj ⊗ L.obj)
              (t.hom.app (M.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj L.obj) ≫
                (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj M.obj) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app L.obj)))) ≅
          Arrow.mk (q.homEquiv (N.obj ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj)
            ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj ⊗ E.obj)
              (s.hom.app (N.obj, (schemeDerivedDirectImage g).obj E.obj) ≫
                (𝟙 ((derivedPullback g).obj N.obj) ⊗ₘ q.counit.app E.obj))))
